trips.name: Madrid I
trips.blurb: Sunday at El Rastro flea market, a picnic in Retiro, and finally settling whether the churros at San Ginés live up to the hype.
trips.imageAlt: Madrid's Gran Vía at dusk, with the domed Metrópolis building lit up on the corner

trips.name: Seville
trips.blurb: Plaza de España at golden hour, the tiled courtyards of the Real Alcázar, and a flamenco show in Triana that doesn't feel like a tourist trap.
trips.imageAlt: The sweeping brick crescent and canal of Plaza de España in Seville under a blue sky

trips.name: London I
trips.blurb: The Crown Jewels at the Tower of London, a cheap last-minute West End seat, and a proper Sunday roast in a pub older than our country.
trips.imageAlt: Tower Bridge in London glowing in golden-hour light over the Thames

trips.name: Granada
trips.blurb: Sunset over the Alhambra from the Mirador de San Nicolás, the Nasrid Palaces up close, and Granada's best rule: every drink comes with free tapas.
trips.imageAlt: The Alhambra fortress on its wooded hill in Granada with the snowy Sierra Nevada behind

trips.name: San Sebastián + Bilbao
trips.blurb: A pintxos crawl through San Sebastián's old town, a very cold dip at La Concha, and the giant flower-covered Puppy outside the Guggenheim.
trips.imageAlt: La Concha beach in San Sebastián, crowded with sunbathers, with the city and hills behind

trips.name: Budapest
trips.blurb: Steaming outdoor pools at Széchenyi Baths, the Parliament lit up on the Danube, and lángos (fried dough with sour cream) for breakfast.
trips.imageAlt: The Hungarian Parliament building lit up at dusk and reflected in the Danube

trips.name: Madrid II + Toledo
trips.blurb: Round two of Madrid plus a day in Toledo's hilltop old town, with a bocadillo de calamares I've been told is non-negotiable.
trips.imageAlt: Panorama of Toledo's old town on its hill, wrapped by the Tagus river gorge

trips.name: Morocco
trips.blurb: Mint tea on a rooftop as Jemaa el-Fnaa's night market fires up, the cobalt-blue Jardin Majorelle, and my first real hammam.
trips.imageAlt: Jemaa el-Fnaa square in Marrakech at sunset with market stalls and the Koutoubia minaret

trips.name: Amsterdam
trips.blurb: Rembrandt's Night Watch at the Rijksmuseum, a canal-side bike ride where I try not to fall in, and stroopwafels straight off the iron.
trips.imageAlt: An arched bridge with string lights over an Amsterdam canal at dusk, lined with gabled houses

trips.name: Lisbon + Porto
trips.blurb: Tram 28 rattling up through Alfama, pastéis de nata still warm in Belém, then a port tasting in the cellars across the river from Porto.
trips.imageAlt: A yellow vintage tram passing pastel buildings in Lisbon's Alfama neighborhood

trips.name: Rome + Florence
trips.blurb: Standing inside the Colosseum, Botticelli's Venus at the Uffizi, and an honest attempt at gelato in every neighborhood of Florence.
trips.imageAlt: Florence's terracotta rooftops with the Duomo and Palazzo Vecchio tower, seen from a hillside terrace

trips.name: Athens + Naxos
trips.blurb: The Acropolis first thing in the morning before the crowds, then a ferry to Naxos for beaches, gyros, and absolutely no homework.
trips.imageAlt: The Acropolis and Parthenon on their rocky hill above Athens, framed by green trees

trips.name: London II
trips.blurb: One last stop before flying home: Borough Market, Westminster Abbey, and a Thames Clipper to Greenwich to straddle the Prime Meridian.
trips.imageAlt: Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament at sunset with light trails from passing buses
